lots.title: Ely Library - Engage, Design and Fit Out
lots.description: Single-lot design-and-build engagement between Cambridgeshire County Council (Authority) and the appointed Supplier for the provision of design, furniture, signage and carpet to refresh the public library offer at Ely Library. Supplier responsibilities include a site visit and stakeholder consultation at Ely Library, preparing initial design proposals, incorporating one round of Authority feedback into revised proposals, and (only after the Authority's written approval of the final design) manufacturing, delivering and installing all furniture, signage, carpet and associated items in accordance with the approved design and any Authority installation requirements. The draft contract document itself does not enumerate separate lots and Schedule 1 'Specification' is an empty placeholder; the project is clearly a single-scope engagement, consistent with the existing single-lot entry on the notice.
requirements: Provide the Services with reasonable care and skill and in accordance with Best Industry Practice (clause 4.2(a)).
Ensure all goods, materials, standards and techniques used in providing the Services are of the best quality and free from defects in workmanship, installation and design (clause 4.2(b)).
Obtain, maintain and comply with all Necessary Consents at the Supplier's own cost (clause 4.2(c)).

Undertake all design engagement activities required by the Authority, including a site visit at Ely Library and reasonable stakeholder consultation; prepare initial design proposals; incorporate one round of Authority feedback into revised proposals (clauses 4.3(a)-(c)).

Ensure all design proposals comply with applicable accessibility standards, including dementia-friendly and autism-friendly design principles aligned with the Authority's sustainability objectives (clause 4.4).
Do not commence manufacture, delivery or installation of any items until the Authority has provided express written approval of the final design (clause 4.5).

Deliver and install all furniture, signage, carpet and any associated items required under the Agreement in accordance with the approved design and any installation requirements specified by the Authority (clause 4.6).

Prior to commencing any works, prepare and submit Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) specific to Ely Library, taking into account first-floor access constraints, delivery windows and any site-specific requirements; do not begin works until the Authority has approved the RAMS in writing (clause 4.7).
Comply with all applicable Law and with the Authority's Mandatory Policies throughout performance of the Agreement (clause 5.1).
Comply with all applicable Law regarding health and safety and with the Authority's Health and Safety Policy whilst at the Authority Premises (clause 5.2(a)-(b)).
Comply with all applicable environmental Law, including waste disposal and the handling of hazardous and toxic materials (clause 6.1(a)).

Implement and maintain carbon-reduction measures consistent with the Authority's Climate Charter (energy-efficient practices, reduced fossil-fuel usage, low-carbon technologies, materials and transport) (clause 6.2(b)).
Implement and maintain waste-minimisation measures (prevent, reduce, reuse or recycle wherever reasonably practicable; environmentally responsible disposal) (clause 6.2(c)).

Provide evidence of carbon-reduction and waste-minimisation measures on request (records, plans, policies, audits, reporting) and cooperate with Authority sustainability or environmental reporting (clause 6.2(d)-(e)).

On exit, provide full documentation of all materials, components, equipment and associated warranties (including manufacturer warranties, maintenance instructions and compliance certificates), and deliver an in-person handover with on-site training for Authority Personnel (clause 7.9(a)-(c)).
Comply with all applicable requirements of the Data Protection Legislation, acting as Processor to the Authority's Controller for any Personal Data processing (clause 21.1-21.2).
Maintain appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect Personal Data against unauthorised or unlawful processing and against accidental loss, destruction or damage (clause 21.2(b)).

warnings.message: Document was classified as 'technical_specification' in the extraction record, but the actual content is a draft Services Agreement (contract) for the Ely Library engage/design/fit-out project. Schedule 1 'Specification' exists as a heading on p.47 but contains only a placeholder comment - no actual specification clauses are present. Substantive scope statements were extracted from contract clauses 4-7 rather than from a specification schedule.

Schedule 1 Specification on p.47 is an empty placeholder. An inline drafter comment (FB20) suggests adding warranty requirements (12-month workmanship warranty, manufacturer warranties for furniture, signage, carpet, warranty pack and care instructions at handover) but these are not yet operative specification clauses.

No tender evaluation / award criteria are present in this document. The document is a post-award draft contract (clauses reference the Supplier's Tender at Schedule 3 as already-submitted). Evaluation criteria for the procurement would live in a separate ITT/specification document, not in this appendix.

CPV codes (39155000-3 Library furniture; 79932000-6 Interior design services) were not restated within the draft contract text. Codes were carried forward from notice-level process_context metadata because they are clearly consistent with the contract scope (design, furniture, signage, carpet for a public library).

The four product_requirement_seeds (furniture, signage, carpet, design service) are qualitative only. The draft contract does not specify types, materials, dimensions, unit counts, coverage area or any quantitative product attributes - all detail is deferred to the post-contract design engagement stage. Downstream matching will need to treat these as category-level seeds, not SKU-level requirements.

Technical standards extracted are regulatory / legal frameworks (Data Protection Legislation, Bribery Act 2010, Modern Slavery Act 2015, environmental law, accessibility principles, Best Industry Practice, RAMS, Health and Safety Policy) rather than product standards such as BS EN or ISO references. No BS/EN/ISO/UKCA product standards are cited in the draft contract.

Docling extraction reported 'No structured tables were detected in the exported document.' The Contents Clause on p.2-3 renders as text with inline dot leaders (not as a parsed table). This does not affect substantive content extraction.

The draft contract does not split the engagement into numbered lots. A single Lot 1 'Ely Library - Engage, Design and Fit Out' is emitted, consistent with the existing single lot already present on the notice (pc-19574d11-0929-f111-813c-005056b64545-lot-1). Lot numbering and title are stable against the existing notice lot.
